primary_metric: validation average precision; report every configuration
threshold_policy: Fixed 0.5; no validation threshold tuning, probability recalibration or automatic winner selection.
weight_policy: Unweighted primary controls; balanced sensitivity weights n_train/(2*n_train_class), never validation-fitted.
scope: Full development baseline comparison; retrospective VulnCheck snapshot listing, not future exploitation.
review: Engineering-reviewed rules; independent semantic annotation and upstream label-acquisition validation remain incomplete.
evaluation: Existing development roles unchanged; previously observed test and excluded CVEs never exported or scored. No new untouched-test claim.
representations: TF-IDF description and current CVSS/reference count; source masks only as a separate shortcut diagnostic. No summaries/posts text, EPSS, TPG/GNN or embeddings consumed.
selection: No grid, early stopping, seed search, model promotion or further tuning in this protocol. All eight fits plus a training-prevalence constant are reported.
uncertainty: Descriptive validation comparisons only. No independent-test or statistical-significance claim; repeated development use and shared text are disclosed.
approval_scope: User-requested bounded development comparison only. Not approval of source truth, historical availability or final evaluation.
